events.title: ADALITA (GOLD COAST)
events.description: Released in 2011, Adalita’s self-titled debut marked the beginning of her remarkable solo journey. Raw, intimate, and emotionally fearless, it struck a deep chord with listeners and remains one of the most beloved and influential Australian releases of its time. To mark its fifteenth anniversary, Adalita reunites with original collaborator JP Shilo to perform the album in full, revisiting the songs that first began this extraordinary chapter. Coinciding with the tour, Adalita will also be reissued on vinyl through Mushroom Music, bringing a long out-of-print favourite back to fans fifteen years on. Don’t miss these special shows. Supported by JP Shilo and more. WILL SELL OUT / GET IN EARLY! Doors at 7pm. El Ranchero back deck/bar and Spanish Girl Food Co will be open from 6pm for preshow dinner and drinks. ADALITA Mo's Desert Clubhouse (GOLD COAST) Thursday 24 September 2026 // 7pm doors $40+BF online GA or $50 door if still available // 18+ Mo's is Burleigh Heads' most loved music venue, licensed bars, creative studios and cultural hub. The Warehouse & El Ranchero both boast epic bar menus, cocktails and craft beers. Mo's is a fully licensed venue, all guests are required to show ID on entry. Tickets will only be refunded through event cancellation or production of a medical certificate within 24hrs of show doors.
